meta.title: Completing a function with return type `()` inserts a semicolon even when in an expression
meta.fix_ref: rust-lang/rust-analyzer#21032 (Fix complete unit return semicolon in arg-list)
meta.build_notes: GitHub release assets rust-analyzer-aarch64-apple-darwin.gz of the weekly tags 2025-12-15 and 2025-12-22; git tag --contains puts the fix first in 2025-12-22. The sysroot is the local rustup toolchain (rustc 1.98.1).
meta.notes: Completion of a unit-returning function appends ';' when the call looks like a statement; inside an argument list the result 'called_function();' is a syntax error.

settings_note: The issue names no settings; the session keeps checkOnSave off (native analysis only).

files.note: a binary crate around the snippet (package name, version, edition 2021)

repro.steps: Open src/main.rs. Request completion right after 'ca' in 'higher_order_function(ca /* cursor */);' (line 5, character 28) and accept called_function. Reported: 'higher_order_function(called_function(););', a syntax error. Probe: the edited text must have no parse error that the original did not have.
